{{Otheruses|Jammer}}
The '''auditory jammer''' or '''acoustical jammer''' was a device designed and built by the [[entertainer]] [[Keenos]]. It nullified every [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] in a ten-step radius, allowing Keenos to conduct private conversations in the [[Atrium]] of the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]].<ref name="Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures">[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]</ref>
